join: exact scientific binomial, no synonym or fuzzy matches

used_definitions.Diet: Species is herbivorous (consumes mostly plants), carnivorous (eats only animal matter), or omnivorous (eats animal and plant matter.
used_definitions.Active time: Whether a species is diurnal, nocturnal, cathemeral, crepuscular or polyphasic.
used_definitions.Maximum Longevity (years): Longevity data are the maximum age (in years) reported for each species from the literature.
used_definitions.Maximum length (\"SVL\", mm)/straight ca: We collected "Maximum length" for Crocodylia, Rhynchocephalia, Squamata and Amphisbaenia. But Testudines included in the same colum but different measure "straight carapace length for turtles".
used_definitions.Reproductive mode: Whether a species is oviparous or viviparous, or whether there are reports on both parity modes “mixed” (ovoviviparous).

excluded_fields.Maximum body mass (g): Mixed measured and allometrically derived source entries; omitted rather than emitted as measured maxima.
excluded_fields.Microhabitat: Source inconsistency: Crocodylus porosus marked Arboreal/Saxicolous/Terrestrial. Entire column omitted.
excluded_fields.SVL and sex-specific lengths: Source inconsistency: Sphenodon punctatus maximum SVL 800 mm appears to be total length. All non-turtle SVL omitted; no inferred conversions.
